title: HUD Archives news release: HUD and Census Bureau Release Findings of 2021 Rental Housing Finance Survey

history.reason: Source read directly on the access date; findings transcribed from the document.

publisher: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development
source_type: Government news release summarizing a Census Bureau survey
reliability: Primary release of HUD/Census survey results.
findings: Of the 49.5 million U.S. rental housing units, nearly 46 percent are in rental properties of one to four units.
Of those small rental properties, 70 percent (15.9 million) are owned by individual investors, and more than one-third (8.1 million) have a mortgage or similar debt.

The Rental Housing Finance Survey is funded by HUD and collected every three years by the Census Bureau; it covers property configuration, ownership and management, rental income and expenses, financing and capital improvements.
limitations: News-release summary only; tables on management practices, rent collection or tenant screening were not read.
